violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Employee was observed rinsing off gloved hands at the 3 bay sink. When gloves become soiled or torn, gloves must be removed and food employees must wash their hands before putting on new gloves. Hand-washing must be done at the designated hand-washing sink. PIC washed hands and put on new gloves. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
The service area is lacking a hand-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2026
Inspector observed case of potatoes stored on the floor in the kitchen area in a puddle of liquid. PIC disposed of potatoes. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw egg) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as beverages) in the retail refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ladle) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC placed in sink to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Beef and chicken, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Various items were observed held between 116-131 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated or disposed of due to quality. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Mayo was observed held at 74 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Chemical bottles were observed stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. PIC relocated chemicals. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
Per interview with PIC, establishment makes their own cheese and sells it retail. PIC informed to submit cheese making process RIDOH and to stop until approved. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. - Inspector observed shredded beef in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep still cooling from the day before. - Inspector observed larges pieces of chicken in the refrigerator in a container with lid still cooling from the day before. PIC disposed of both items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Working containers of ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Cheese, tortilla, snack, and spices packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
Inspector observed sticky fly trap handing above food prep area. PIC informed to relocate trap away from food areas. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The presence of large flies are not controlled as evidenced by live large flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
Inspector observed sticky fly trap filled with dead flies in the kitchen and dining areas. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
Potatoes were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Inspector observed employees using towels/blankets to cover/protect food. Inspector informed PIC to use lids, plastic wrap, or foil to cover food and to remove blankets. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
Ice cream scoop was observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Wood is used in the construction of steam table lifts in the service area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2026
Inspector observed gap between two connected table tops. Gap was observed with food residue. Establishment should clean and seal gap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - prep units - prep tables - shelves under prep tables - all equipment with original packaging still intact (film must be removed) Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. PIC covered. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed behind establishment. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The floors, walls, and air vents throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The walls in the mop sink closet are constructed of dry wall. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
The ceiling tiles in the bathroom area is in poor repair (previous water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (wall vegetable chopper) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch.PIC washed and sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (stove hoods and exterior oven) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (wall vegetable chopper and ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The cutting boards in the (kitchen) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
(Walk in freezer and prep unit ) located in the (kitchen ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 71-72DF New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation debris: -equipment -can opener -stove hoods -food storage racks in the walk in cooler New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
